headline: Andy Burnham heads to Brussels as UK and EU close in on Brexit reset deal – live

members.title: Andy Burnham heads to Brussels as UK and EU close in on Brexit reset deal – live
Fallout over tuition fees may snag Burnham’s EU deal, say insiders
members.lead: Discord between EU and UK on whether arrangements for food and drink, emissions trading and youth mobility scheme depend on settlement for students UK-EU summit live – latest news updates The UK and EU have agreed a reset deal, Downing Street has said, although the level of tuition fees EU students will pay to study at UK universities remains unresolved. “The deal is done – negotiations have concluded,” a No 10 statement said, less than an hour after the prime minister, Andy Burnham, arrived at the summit venue in Brussels, where he was greeted by Ursula von der Leyen, the European Commission president, and António Costa, the European Council president.
